scope: Integrity/static inventory only; no QGIS, database or notebook rebuild or native retest
selected_database_gdal: GDAL3.10.3 retained CMake cache has GDAL_USE_EXTERNAL_LIBS=OFF and GDAL_USE_OPENJPEG=OFF. Actual retained gdalinfo--formats contains no JP2 driver. OpenJPEG2.5.4 was discovered on host by CMake but explicitly not selected.
selected_qgis: QGIS selects its own source-built GDAL3.10.3 in qgis-candidate/spatial-04/prefix, distinct from database postgis-slice/run-003/prefix. The selected configuration and historical desktop/server mappings agree. Its own cache has GDAL_USE_EXTERNAL_LIBS=OFF; OpenJPEG include/library are NOTFOUND and GDAL_USE_OPENJPEG has no cache entry. Its own retained gdalinfo--formats has no JP2 driver. The database prefix remains a separate dependency source for selected GEOS/libpq and supporting libraries; it is not QGIS selected GDAL.
selected_notebooks: Retained dependency lock and native linkage inventory have no OpenJPEG/Pillow/rasterio entry. This does not promise that arbitrary user-installed notebook packages or future kernels lack JPEG2000.
java: Parent WAR has only JAIJJ2000 codecs; no packaged OpenJPEG/GDAL/Kakadu. OpenPDF JPEG2000 embedding and PDFBox optional ImageIO lookup are retained indirect consumers guarded/rejected at selected MapFish routes.
removal_scope: Affected Java/server candidate only; no unrelated profile purged and no universal project-wide format-removal claim.
selected_qt_plugins: support-07 contains and historical QGIS maps load exactly libqgif.so, libqico.so, libqjpeg.so and libqsvg.so in its imageformats directory; no QtImageFormats module package or libqjp2 plugin is selected. The qtimageformats-named qdoc example file is documentation, not a codec plugin.
retained_qgis_jpeg2000_metadata: Exiv2 0.28.9 remains selected and historically loaded with JP2 metadata read/write APIs. Static symbols/header confirm this unchanged metadata path; selected ELF has no direct OpenJPEG dependency. No QGIS-wide JPEG2000 removal or denial is claimed.
correction: Earlier same spatial/GDAL prefix wording conflated two distinct selected profiles and is corrected here using QGIS own cache, configuration, formats output and runtime mappings. Database OpenJPEG2.5.4 discovery/OFF statements apply only to database run003.
